greeting.text: Hi, I'm Abu, based in Shanghai

I'm an enterprise AI production engineer — I help tech leads and business teams turn RAG, Agents, and document intelligence into systems that are deployable, measurable, and operable.
If your knowledge base cites the wrong passages, document parsing is broken, or Agents won't ship — send me the status quo.

featured.title: Production cases
featured.subtitle: Three buyer-pain stories — more capabilities in the project library below

items.title: Lots of reports filed — the knowledge base still cites the wrong passages
items.subtitle: Finance RAG · parsing and chunking · rerank and eval
items.description: A mid-size research/news team: docs were ingested, Q&A still missed the point. Goal: a shippable knowledge Q&A with an observable pipeline. Fix parsing and chunking first, then add freshness/authority rerank — not a bigger model.
highlights: Rebuilt report/filing parsing and semantic chunking with async parallel ingest
Added freshness and source-authority rerank plus recall-path logging and eval
Delivered scalable Docker Compose deploy with handoff and rollback in mind

items.title: Scans and messy layouts drag the whole RAG project into the mud
items.subtitle: PDF / OCR / TOC / watermark cleanup
items.description: Common enterprise KB blockers: scans, tables, watermarks, missing TOC hierarchy. Goal: turn dirty docs into structured, searchable input. Prefer rules + coordinates when stable; bring VL/OCR when layout complexity demands it.
highlights: Built PDF structure parsing and table recognition into clean Markdown/trees
Rule-based cleanup to lift OCR baselines; three-tier TOC extraction fallback
Wrapped high-concurrency parse APIs for downstream chunking and embedding

items.title: As the group scales, risk control / escrow / support cannot stay manual
items.subtitle: Community bot · escrow reconciliation · observability
items.description: A commercial community outgrew manual verification, anti-spam, escrow trades, and support tickets. Delivery focus: stability, reconciliation loops, and operable ops — not feature sprawl.
highlights: Automated join verification, anti-spam, and risk governance
Built VIP-group escrow and financial reconciliation to cut human error
Shipped an ops console and ticketing for a monitorable commercial loop
